Call regions that differ between two states

Source: R/group_compare.R
call_diff_groups.Rd

Regions measured in both states are classified by the log2 fold change M (treatment / reference): <treatment>_up when M > thres, <treatment>_down when M < -thres, otherwise no_sig. Regions with a value in only one state are appended as <treatment>_up (treatment only) or <treatment>_down (reference only).

Usage

call_diff_groups(df, id_col, feature, thres, states = c("ctr", "ama"))

Arguments

df

data.frame with the id_col column(s), a state column and feature.

id_col

Name(s) of the identifier column(s).

feature

Name of the value column.

thres

Threshold on the absolute log2 fold change.

states

The two state names, c(reference, treatment).

Value

A data.frame with id_col and the factor iz_group (levels <treatment>_up, <treatment>_down, no_sig).

Examples

long <- data.frame(id = rep(c("a", "b", "c"), 2),
                   state = rep(c("ctr", "ama"), each = 3),
                   usage = c(1, 2, NA, 4, 2, 5))
call_diff_groups(long, "id", "usage", thres = 1)
#>   id iz_group
#> 1  a   ama_up
#> 2  b   no_sig
#> 3  c   ama_up
